Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
**FADE IN:**

**INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY**

The Camera pans across a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and dignitaries. At the center of it all stands 127-year-old Henry Jenkins, a frail but determined man with a twinkle in his eye. He is presented with a plaque and a certificate, and the room erupts in applause as the officials announce that Henry has been awarded the world record for Oldest Human to Ever Live.

**CUT TO:**

**INT. HENRY'S BEDROOM - NIGHT**

Henry lies in bed, the plaque and certificate from earlier in the day still clutched in his hand. He gazes up at the ceiling, a faraway look in his eyes. Suddenly, his mind wanders back to his youth, when he spent countless hours browsing the internet.

**HENRY (V.O.)**

I Remember Reading About This Theory... Quantum Immortality. It Said That In A Multiverse, Every Time A Person Dies, Their Consciousness Creates A New Reality, Where They Survive. I Thought It Was Just A Crazy Idea, But Now... Now I'm Not So Sure.

As Henry's mind continues to wander, his thoughts become increasingly disjointed. He starts to see visions of himself living multiple lives, each one a parallel universe where he has survived every illness, every injury, and every tragedy.

**HENRY (V.O.)**

I've Lived So Many Lives... So Many Deaths. But Which One Is Real? Which One Is Me?

Henry's eyes widen in terror as he realizes the implications of the theory. He starts to laugh maniacally, his body shaking with sobs.

**CUT TO:**

**INT. HENRY'S BEDROOM - LATER**

Henry's body is wracked with convulsions, his mind shattered by the weight of his own immortality. He screams at the top of his lungs, the sound echoing through the empty room.

**HENRY (V.O.)**

I'M NOT ALIVE! I'M NOT DEAD! I'M JUST... JUST... (he trails off into incoherent mumbling)

The camera zooms out as Henry's body collapses onto the bed, his mind consumed by the infinite possibilities of the multiverse.

**FADE TO BLACK.**

**THE END.**
